_about: Construction assemblies with takeoff factors, for quantity/material estimating. Factors are standard framing rules of thumb; they produce a material list, not a stamped structural design. Openings, corners, blocking and waste are handled by the factors and the waste allowance noted per assembly. Always confirm structural sizing and code-required insulation/fire ratings against the current Ontario Building Code and your engineer/designer.

linear_assemblies._unit: per linear foot of wall, at the assembly's nominal height

2x4 plate (bottom + double top).note: linear feet of plate = 3 x wall length
